Conventions: line numbers exactly as in SEAL (manuscript siglum + column + line; primes = line count from first preserved line). <sup>…</sup> = determinatives/superscript signs; subscript digits in sigla rendered as Unicode (C₀). Italics (Akkadian vs. Sumerogram distinction) are NOT preserved here – see the raw HTML. Under each line, lemmas: lists SEAL's lemmatisation (lemma + gloss) for that line.
